The search stops at the first matching id/category before checking its kind. If an agent advertises a same-named non-Select entry before the valid Select entry, capability discovery incorrectly fails instead of continuing to the valid selector. For Copilot, this accepts `allow_all` without the required `off` value whenever its current value is some other advertised value: the checks only require `on` plus the current value, which is then captured as the restore value. That weakens the exact selector contract described by this PR and can treat a lookalike option as the privileged allow-all control. Require Copilot's complete `on`/`off` value set before enabling native Yolo.
